VoiceConvert.fileInvalid: Choose an MP3, WAV or FLAC file within the selected configuration's size limit.
VoiceConvert.semitoneHint: Leave blank or 0 to keep the source key; the key is never estimated automatically. A non-zero value shifts explicitly between -12 and +12 semitones.

AudioSeparate.running: Preparing the audio or separating stems…
AudioSeparate.configureInputs: Choose a ready audio separation configuration and import a source recording.
AudioSeparate.inputHint: MP3, WAV or FLAC · one recording to split into vocals and background
AudioSeparate.fileInvalid: Choose a non-empty MP3, WAV or FLAC recording.
AudioSeparate.rangeHint: Leave both blank for the whole recording. Frame positions always refer to the prepared canonical input.
AudioSeparate.includeInstrumentParts: Also return instrument stems (drums, bass, other)
AudioSeparate.instrumentPartsHint: Instrument stems are returned only when requested and actually produced by the model — never as silent or substituted stand-ins.
AudioSeparate.preparationHint: Audio is decoded to canonical PCM before submission. Stopping during preparation prevents the Job from starting once decoding finishes.
AudioSeparate.recoveryMissingJob: This separation was recorded before its job was identified, so it cannot be recovered. Remove the record to abandon it.
AudioSeparate.derivation: The source was prepared as canonical PCM before submission. When its sample rate or channel layout differs from the selected implementation's input domain (HTDemucs: 44.1 kHz stereo), this App first requests one explicit derived conversion, and the source shown here is that converted input. No hidden downmix or channel change is applied; the stems are shown exactly as returned.
